translations.跨域目标 · 团队路由 · 全局依赖 · Join: Cross-domain goal · Team routing · Global dependencies · Join

translations.每一层只接收完成本层责任所需的目标、上下文、权限和预算。: Each layer receives only the goals, context, permissions, and budget needed for its responsibility.

translations.它保存业务因果与引用；Checkpoint、Artifact、Trace 和 K: It preserves business causality and references; Checkpoint, Artifact, Trace, and Knowledge each remain independently authoritative.
